text: Implemented immutable phased assembly for emissions/support/event validation and summaries/source hash and lineage/gaps/labels and reports. Direct APIs drain the same work; feeding counts remain exact and assembly phases report Unknown totals. Frozen full benchmark is running; raised only observation step cap from 2m to 8m to cover the additional smallest-quantum assembly steps.
